sources.title: Implementing Speed and Separation Monitoring in Collaborative Robot Workcells
sources.titleEn: Implementing Speed and Separation Monitoring in Collaborative Robot Workcells
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 移動機器人定位與建圖
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：能量計算正確但用途受限，所有接觸與夾困缺口列明，沒有發布實機允許速度。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Energy arithmetic is correct but scope-limited, contact/trapping gaps are explicit, and no allowable machine speed is issued.
related.difference: 理解獨立無偏量測的加權融合，並找出共享偏差使過度自信的情境。
related.differenceEn: Understand weighted fusion of independent unbiased measurements and detect overconfidence from shared bias.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 平動近似E=mv²/2；相同能量可因接觸面積、剛性與受夾困條件產生不同後果。 純教學等效質量2 kg，速度0.20 m/s；不代表人體傷害或協作機器人允許值。 E=0.5×2×0.20²=0.040 J；只代表此模型瞬間動能。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TranslationalE=mv²/2 is only an approximation; equal energy can have different consequences with area, stiffness and trapping. Teaching effective mass 2 kg and speed 0.20 m/s; not injury thresholds or permissible collaborative-robot values. E=0.040 J, only the instantaneous kinetic energy of this model.

Independent one-dimensional Gaussian estimates use weights 1/σ², with σf²=1/(1/σ1²+1/σ2²); correlation/bias need separate treatment. Synthetic odometryx 1=1.00 m,σ1=0.10 m; map observationx 2=1.10 m,σ2=0.05 m. xf=1.08 m and σf=√(1/500)=0.044721 m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工業斷層掃描檢測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：能量計算正確但用途受限，所有接觸與夾困缺口列明，沒有發布實機允許速度。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Energy arithmetic is correct but scope-limited, contact/trapping gaps are explicit, and no allowable machine speed is issued.
related.difference: 區分體素取樣間距、空間解析度與缺陷可檢出性，不以一個體素保證看見缺陷。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish voxel sampling, spatial resolution and detectability rather than assuming one voxel guarantees a visible defect.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 平動近似E=mv²/2；相同能量可因接觸面積、剛性與受夾困條件產生不同後果。 純教學等效質量2 kg，速度0.20 m/s；不代表人體傷害或協作機器人允許值。 E=0.5×2×0.20²=0.040 J；只代表此模型瞬間動能。
球孔體積V=4πr³/3，理想體素數V/a³；邊界部分體積與成像模糊使此數不等於實際分割數。 合成球孔半徑0.15 mm，立方體素邊長0.05 mm，均勻體素假設。 V=0.0141372 mm³；理想體素數=113.097，直徑跨6個體素。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TranslationalE=mv²/2 is only an approximation; equal energy can have different consequences with area, stiffness and trapping. Teaching effective mass 2 kg and speed 0.20 m/s; not injury thresholds or permissible collaborative-robot values. E=0.040 J, only the instantaneous kinetic energy of this model.

Sphere volume V=4 πr³/3 gives ideal countV/a³; partial-volume boundaries and blur make this different from actual segmentation. Synthetic spherical pore radius 0.15 mm, cubic voxel side 0.05 mm, uniform sampling. V=0.0141372 mm³; ideal count 113.097, with diameter spanning 6 voxels.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
